report:
Fresh followup review of meta.reviews.review_scope. Preserved the previous input/output, started a new review, read the complete claim and all five associated test bodies, and recaptured the prior dependencies: review fixture helpers lines 1–94, review workflow design, and sage-review-checklist skill. Compared all prior/current fragments by path and selector and compared implementation/test metadata. Only a placeholder_status association comment in review.rs and a test_source attribute on accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence changed. No behavior, assertion, claim, helper, metadata for this anchor, or dependency changed; no fragments were removed. These additions do not alter the complete prior assessment below.

The sole ordinary implementation association covers inventory in review.rs. It creates one ReviewInput for an anchor containing its complete claim, all implementation associations, whole implementation-file context and complete associated test functions. ReviewImplementation serializes exactly crate_name, target, module, file, cfg, excerpt, region, status, explanation; no line or byte positions appear. Its derived ordering and inventory sort/dedup make metadata deterministic. Whole-file capture ensures a point preview is not the behavioral boundary. capture_read appends dependency fragments; input_errors validates initial captures and reselects additional reads, and record preserves saved input rather than replacing it. PROMPT and the captured skill require one judgment of both implementation completeness and test adequacy against every claim aspect, following/capturing relevant helpers and adding associations for essential code elsewhere. These remain reviewer obligations: the tool does not mechanically prove source correctness or infer test execution. The essential assembly/capture/persistence code for this claim is within the already associated review.rs; no additional production association is needed.

All five ordinary tests contain meaningful visible assertions. initial_context_preserves_instructions_and_exact_uniform_fragments compares the complete claim, whole implementation file, exact annotated test source, prompt, coordinator instructions and persisted input. input_keeps_complete_association_metadata_and_appends_context_in_one_collection checks crate/target/module/file/inherited cfg/excerpt/region/status/explanation and confirms captured extra context appends without changing initial fragments or metadata. region_association_preserves_placeholder_explanation_and_excerpt checks nested TODO module identity, true region, exact explanatory content and saved association equality. accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence checks both TODO and N/A classifications/explanations and verifies acceptance leaves zero ordinary approvals and the appropriate placeholder count. Its synthetic backend prerequisite/editorial rationale and the region fixture's numeric-model prerequisite test preservation, not actual deferred behavior of this anchor. implementation_metadata_is_sorted_and_excludes_source_positions checks reverse traversal becomes module-sorted metadata, exact nine serialized keys, and metadata equality after source reordering/leading context changes while whole-file fragments differ. This directly detects accidental positions or traversal-order dependence.

There are no TODO or N/A associations for this anchor. The complete claim, including dependency capture and source-judgment versus execution distinction, is accounted for; the two association-only changes introduce no new gaps. This followup executed review start/read and capture comparisons, followed by record, but no tests, formatting, source edits or workspace build. The previous review's focused test result is historical evidence, not a command executed here. No requested edits.
